description: Rent a GPU pod on Lium with your API key and wait until it runs; returns the pod id and the ssh command. Spends money from your Lium balance: the pod is billed per second until remove_pod, also when idle. Give gpu (and count, optional max_price_per_gpu_hour and country) to let Lium pick the cheapest matching node, or node_id from search_gpus alone for that node. quoted_price_per_gpu_hour caps the price: a node asking more than one cent per GPU-hour above it is not rented. idempotency_key is required: a call with the same key within 24 hours returns the first rental instead of renting again. quote_id is required: the one quote_rent returned for the same gpu or node_id, count, country, template_id and quoted_price_per_gpu_hour; other terms rent nothing.

count.description: GPUs on one node (default: 1 with gpu, every free GPU with node_id)

country.description: Two-letter country code (with gpu, not node_id)

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100, RTX 4090; Lium picks the cheapest node that fits

idempotency_key.description: A unique string per rental (e.g. a UUID). A call with the same key within 24 hours returns the same rental: it never rents twice

max_price_per_gpu_hour.description: Price cap in USD per GPU-hour (with gpu, not node_id)

node_id.description: A node id from search_gpus, to rent that node

quote_id.description: The quote_id quote_rent returned for these terms (valid 30 to 60 minutes)

quoted_price_per_gpu_hour.description: Expected USD per GPU-hour, e.g. search_gpus price_per_gpu_hour; a node asking more than one cent per GPU-hour above it is not rented

ssh_public_key.description: OpenSSH public key to log in with (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub); default: the keys saved on your Lium account

template_id.description: From list_templates; default: Lium's PyTorch image for the node

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the pod to run (default 25, max 50)

name: rent_pod
title: Rent a Lium GPU pod
